items.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
items.summary: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance's own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn't said when it will refill it.

items.title: Bitcoin Firm Strive Climbs Up the Treasury Ranks With Another Big Buy
